maxBytes.description: Largest accepted file in bytes (e.g. 10 MB = 10485760); also sizes the server-action body limit.

types.description: Accepted types (extension or MIME type: pdf or application/pdf, jpg or image/jpeg…), recognised by content (magic bytes), never by name or browser-declared type.

maxFilesPerRecord.description: Files one record (request, task, project…) may hold.

notifyOnUpload.description: Email the members who see every scope (staff) when someone restricted to a scope (a client) uploads; logged when no email provider is configured.

extensions.description: Extensions stated in the request (informative; types decide).

attachTo.description: Record kind files belong to in the request (informative; attachments are wired per record in src/uploads/subjects.ts).

downloadableBy.description: Who downloads (informative): enforced by the record's scope through src/server/record-access.ts.
